Exit: An ancient standing stone etched with glowing runes. Use it to open a gateway to other worlds.
出口: 一块刻满发光符文的古老立石。使用它可打开通往其他世界的传送门。

Exit: A kit containing everything needed to raise a Portal Hub. Place it anywhere — then use the portal to travel to other worlds.
出口: 一套搭建传送枢纽所需的全部材料。将其放置在任意位置——然后使用传送门前往其他世界。

Exit: You begin with a Portal Kit. Place it anywhere to open a gateway to other worlds.
出口: 你初始拥有一个传送门套件。将其放置在任意位置即可打开通往其他世界的传送门。

Exit: Bind a witch stone into fresh fur and dried wolfsbane, sealed with animal fat. Assembles a portable Portal Hub kit.
出口: 将巫石绑入新鲜毛皮与干乌头中，并用动物脂肪密封。制成一套便携式传送枢纽套件。

Exit: A small metal nail, perfect for joining wood. It is the metal it was made from: copper, ghost bronze, tin, tin bronze, white bronze or iron.
出口: 一枚小金属钉，非常适合连接木材。它的金属与制作它的材料相同：铜、幽灵青铜、锡、锡青铜、白青铜或铁。

Exit: Hammer a copper, tin or bronze nugget into a nail of the same metal.
出口: 将铜、锡或青铜金属块锤打成同种金属的钉子。

Exit: Crafted: From a copper, tin or bronze nugget using a hammer, or six at a time by casting a heated copper, tin or bronze bar (one mud brick and one clay as the mould); iron nails are forged from 4 iron nuggets with a hammer (Forge Iron Nails, 4 nails). The nail is the metal of its nugget or bar. Uses: Construction and crafting. A nail of any metal works the same in every recipe, iron included. Smelts: Returns 1 nugget of its own metal in a furnace at 1100°C or hotter.
出口: 制作：用锤子将铜、锡或青铜金属块锤成钉子，或将加热的铜、锡或青铜金属锭浇铸（用1块泥砖和1份黏土作模）一次得到六枚；铁钉用锤子把4块铁块锻造而成（锻造铁钉，产出4枚）。钉子的金属与所用金属块或金属锭相同。 用途：建筑和手工制作材料。任何金属的钉子（包括铁钉）在所有配方中作用相同。 熔炼：在1100°C或更高温度的熔炉中返还1块同种金属的金属块。

Exit: A flat metal sheet, hammered thin. It is the metal it was made from: copper, ghost bronze, tin, tin bronze, white bronze or iron.
出口: 一块锤打成薄片的金属片。它的金属与制作它的材料相同：铜、幽灵青铜、锡、锡青铜、白青铜或铁。

Exit: Hammer a heated lump of metal flat into a copper sheet.
出口: 将加热的金属锭锤打成铜片。

Exit: Hammer 6 iron nuggets flat into an Iron Sheet (a Metal Sheet of Metal Type 200), ready for iron-grade tools and armor.
出口: 把6块铁块锤打成一块铁片（金属类型200的金属片），可用于打造铁质工具和铠甲。

Exit: A tin solder stick. Useful for joining metal parts or sealing seams.
出口: 锡焊料棒。用于连接金属零件或密封接缝。

Exit: Forge 4 iron nuggets into 4 Iron Nails (Metal Nails of Metal Type 200).
出口: 用4块铁块锻造4枚铁钉（金属类型200的金属钉）。

Exit: Melt a tin-grade metal nugget into solder sticks.
Hammer a heated Ghost Bronze, Tin, Tin Bronze or White Bronze bar flat into a sheet of the same metal, ready for alloy armor.
出口: 将加热的幽灵青铜、锡、锡青铜或白青铜锭锤打成同种金属的薄片，可用于打造合金铠甲。

Exit: Cast a heated copper, tin or bronze bar into six nails of the same metal.
